silhouette.reason: A set with three shape families now (round, angular, slab) and a pebble scatter; each outline reads as a boulder.
fixes: one taller, more angular split block so the set is not all low domes

proportions.reason: Sizes from a 0.4 m cobble to a ~2 m boulder, bases sunk into soil patches as asked.
fixes: vary the burial depth so one boulder is half-buried

materials.reason: The soil skirts sit flush with smooth rounded outlines and the dark rim along their long sides is gone (hero.png, front edge); but the edge is still a hard line with no fade into the ground, the soil is one pale tan, and the granite albedo stays soft and blurry.
fixes: fade the soil patch edges (alpha or vertex fade) so they bleed into the ground instead of ending on a line
darker, damper soil tone instead of pale tan
sharper granite grain (feldspar/quartz flecks) in granite.ts

detail.reason: Fissures now cut through the big boulder and the slab and the fracture planes hold, but edges stay rounded and soft in the hero.
fixes: sharper fracture edges (less smoothing on the cuts)
small spalls and chips along the fracture edges

wear.reason: Lichen, moss on the north faces, soil and pebbles at the bases tell where they lie.
fixes: darker damp band at the soil line and moss in the crevices, not only blotches on top

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 soil patches are now one flat soil colour without the plank-like streaks, and the boulders carry the moss-green grey average of LOD0, so colour holds at the switch; the big boulder loses its fissure and shows a few hard flat facets.
fixes: keep the big boulder fissure as a dark band in the LOD2 vertex colour

technical.reason: QA clean; 35k / 5k / 0.4k triangles, 1 draw for the set.
fixes: coarser LOD0 cell on the smallest boulder
